name: roadmap-orchestration
description: Unattended, long-horizon roadmap execution: converge a codebase on a documented target state through a Node executor driving Codex and Claude.

plugins.name: roadmap-orchestrator
plugins.description: A plain Node executor that runs a documented target state to convergence, unattended and long-horizon: `codex exec` and `claude -p` as peer backends, a unit DAG with resource locks, candidate-first merges (the tested head is the published head), and write-ahead recovery. The `claude-only` profile needs no `codex` CLI. Invoke as /roadmap-orchestrator:orchestrate.
